items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Dave Dexter was recording so it was, he was in Kansas City recording and I got in on that.

ctx.x: What was the musical scene like in Kansas City at that time?
Well the day that I got back to Kansas City it was Dave Dexter was recording so it was, he was in Kansas City recording and I got in on that.

items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: that's where I first met Dave Dexter. Dave Dexter was writing for the Journal-Post... and so he came by there and he used to get a kick out of listening to the two of us

ctx.x: And Hop came over and gave me a gig and so I started out there and that's where I first met Dave Dexter. Dave Dexter was writing for the Journal-Post and the paper there, another paper besides the Star, and so he came by there and he used to get a kick out of listening to the two of us, you know. So Dave gave us a write-up in the Journal-Post.
What was the name of the place where you were playing?
